candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis slowness (load, saturation) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout, matching the alert's ~2s 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics to confirm the timeout origin
Gateway logs (excluded) to corroborate error chain
